review.posthog_relevance: Adds Twitter/X as a warehouse ingestion source with rate-limit handling, resumable ingestion, and comprehensive tests.
review.reason: The change adds Twitter support to the warehouse ingestion ecosystem. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F9.H1 establish the Twitter source and its authentication/resource fetching. P1.F2.H1 adds Twitter-specific rate-limit reset handling, P1.F7.H1 switches the implementation to a resumable source for incremental updates, and P1.F8.H1 provides tests. This is a substantive, bounded capability addition

observations.behavior: Replaces SimpleSource with ResumableSource, adding resume configuration and manager, and switching TwitterSource to use incremental field support.

The ResumableSourceManager and TwitterResumeConfig are instantiated and passed to the pipeline, indicating the implementation of checkpointing and resume capability.
